predecessors.name: Golden Horde
predecessors.text: the Tura and Tobol valleys round Tyumen, 'under the White Horde and then the Golden Horde from 1242 to 1468'

successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: the Tobol, Irtysh and Ob lands taken by the Cossack and Russian forts of 1582-1598 (Qashliq 1582, Tyumen 1586, Tobolsk 1587, Berezov 1593, Surgut and Tara 1594, Narym 1598)

ledger.x: 1428: Abu'l-Khayr Khan is chosen khan on the Tura at Tyumen.

ledger.cp: Kazhy Mohammed (Muhammad Khan), khan of Sibir before 1428

ledger.x: 1440: the Kazakh steppe joins the Sibir shape.
1446: the khan's seat moves to Sighnaq on the Syr Darya.
1487: Aqmola, Pavlodar and Qostanay pass to the Kazakh Khanate on Cliopatria's map (1,326 cells).
1495: Mamut kills Ibak and takes Sibir.
About 1495-1496: the capital passes from Tyumen to Sibir (Qashliq).
1582: Qashliq falls and Kuchum retreats into the steppe.
1593: Russia founds Berezov on the lower Ob.
1598: Narym is founded on the upper Ob.
August 1598: Kuchum is beaten at the Irmen.

wars.name: Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Khwarazm and Syr Darya campaigns
wars.outcome: Abu'l-Khayr occupies Urgench in 1430-1431, attacks Khwarazm again in 1435-1436, invades the Syr Darya in 1446 and makes Sighnaq his capital.

wars.name: Ibak Khan's war against the Great Horde
wars.outcome: Ibak and the Nogai Yamgurchi kill Ahmed Khan of the Great Horde on 6 January 1481; no frontier moves on the page.

wars.name: Kuchum's raids on Perm
wars.outcome: After the Russo-Crimean War of 1571, Kuchum stops paying tribute (1573) and raids the Perm lands.

wars.name: Russian conquest of the Khanate of Sibir (Yermak's campaign)
wars.outcome: Yermak enters Qashliq on 26 October 1582; Cossack and Russian forts follow at Tyumen (1586), Tobolsk (1587), Berezov (1593), Surgut and Tara (1594) and Narym (1598); Kuchum is beaten on the Irmen in August 1598.

certainty.note: A forest, steppe and river realm without surveyed frontiers: the pages name the Tobol, Irtysh, Ishim, Ob and Tura, the lower Ob in the north and the Skewbald Horde to the east.
